```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
```

Step 1: load data and filter desireble gene
```{r}
#load data
covar <- read.csv("/Users/ariadnamerino/Downloads/GSE85307_covar-1.csv")
geneExpression <- read.csv("/Users/ariadnamerino/Downloads/GSE85307_geneExpression.csv") |> 
  column_to_rownames("X")
geneNames <- read.csv("/Users/ariadnamerino/Downloads/GSE85307_geneNames.csv")
#Check dataset
dim(covar)
dim(geneExpression)
dim(geneNames)

#ID for the STIR3
geneNames %>%
  filter(GENE == "SSTR3")
```
Step 2: Cleaning and matching our data.
```{r}
STR.ID <-geneNames[which(geneNames$GENE== "SSTR3") , "PROBEID"]
STR.ID <- as.character(STR.ID)

t(geneExpression)[ ,STR.ID]

row.names(covar)
t(geneExpression)[ covar$geoID,STR.ID]

covar$SSTR3 <- t(geneExpression)[ covar$geoID,STR.ID]

# Continuous covariate: Maternal Vitamin D
covar$mat_vitD <- as.numeric(
  sub(".*: ", "", covar$mat_vitD)
)

# Categorical covariate 1: Preeclampsia
covar$preg_preeclampsia <- factor(
  sub(".*: ", "", covar$preg_preeclampsia)
)

# Clean maternal BMI
covar$mat_BMI <- as.numeric(
  sub(".*: ", "", covar$mat_BMI)
)

# Categorical covariate 2: BMI group
covar$BMI_group <- ifelse(
  covar$mat_BMI < 25,
  "BMI below 25",
  "BMI 25 or higher"
)

covar$BMI_group <- factor(covar$BMI_group)

# Check the variables
summary(covar$mat_vitD)
table(covar$preg_preeclampsia)
table(covar$BMI_group, useNA = "ifany")
```
Step 4:Calculate the median of maternal age 
```{r}
#Cleanaing maternal data
covar$mat_age_yrs <- as.numeric(
  sub(".*: ", "", covar$mat_age_yrs)
)

#Calculate maternal median age
median(covar$mat_age_yrs, na.rm = TRUE)

```
Step 5: Graph1-HISTOGRAM
```{r}
plot1 <- ggplot(covar, aes(x = SSTR3)) +
  geom_histogram(
    bins = 20,
    fill = "plum",
    color = "white",
    linewidth = 0.4
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Distribution of SSTR3 Gene Expression",
    x = "SSTR3 Gene Expression",
    y = "Number of Participants"
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(
      face = "bold",
      size = 15,
      hjust = 0.5
    ),
    axis.title = element_text(
      face = "bold",
      size = 12
    ),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 11)
  )
plot1
```
